About me
Behind the calendar

I'm Ossel, an Executive Assistant and Administrative professional based in the Philippines. I've spent 8+ years keeping executives organised, inboxes managed, and operations running smoothly — across government, legal, and corporate settings.

I'm the person who notices what needs to be done before being asked. Whether it's a last-minute travel change, a report that needs to be ready by tomorrow, or a calendar conflict that needs untangling — I handle it with discretion and calm.

I'm fully remote-ready, available across US, UK, and AU time zones, and committed to long-term working relationships built on trust.
